lines.2: 「Well, it's started raining, so let's get home already.」
lines.3: 「Oh, Yoshimi. Sorry to ask just because you know Kurogane, but...」
lines.4: 「If she comes by, tell her I already went home.」
lines.5: 「--Wait, that won't work without an excuse.」
lines.6: 「How about saying it's your day for abacus lessons? Sounds classy, right?」
lines.7: 「Yeah, I like the subtle sarcasm. Let's go with that.」
lines.9: I felt bad for leaving Yoshimi confused, but it couldn't be helped.
lines.10: The last thing I needed was the disciplinary committee watching me.
lines.12: 「Sato, do you know where Tsushima is?」
lines.13: 「H-He said it was time for his abacus lessons...」
lines.14: 「The abacus... It certainly is an effective learning method.」
lines.15: 「But then he should have told me at lunch. We have missed each other yet again...」
lines.18: 「Oh dear, she bought it. Most people wouldn't, but then Otome is so terribly earnest.」
lines.19: 「If she finds out he lied, Tsushima won't get off lightly.」
lines.20: 「I wonder why Kurogane is so concerned with Tsushima, though.」
lines.21: 「He looks put together, but he can be surprisingly careless. Maybe she feels she has to keep him in line.」
lines.23: 「Oh, right. More importantly, Yoppi, did you bring an umbrella?」
lines.24: 「You know I always carry a folding one for emergencies.」
lines.28: 「You really should check the weather forecast.」
lines.29: 「I felt like having sunshine today, so I thought perhaps it would simply stay sunny.」
lines.30: 「But I've already decided I'm walking home with you, Yoppi.」
